name: Smart Sampling System (SSS)
summary: Solves persistent plugging problems in CEMS applications by continuously delivering stack sample gas to any CEMS analyser, including severe-service applications in hazardous area locations.
intro: The SSS provides a solution to the persistent plugging problems that plague the CEMS application. The SSS is an innovative design to continuously deliver stack sample gas to any CEMS analysers and for use in severe service applications in Hazardous Area Locations. The integrated heating and blowback system extremely reduces the requirement for maintenance and provides reliable operation.

The Smart Sampling System (SSS) includes a specific PLC Controller with two HMI (12" at SSC & 7" at SSP) to monitor the entire SSS system, allow manual and remote changes to all essential system parameters & initiation of functions. The 7" HMI at the Smart Sample Probe (SSP) helps the operator diagnose the SSS system while at heights.

The SSS Controller (SSC) integrates accurate temperature management of its Smart Sample Probe (SSP) heated components, Sample Line as well as configurable sample system blowback functions to clean its Heated Sample Probe, Heated Sample Filter, and Heated Sample Line Tube using instrument air blowback operations.
features: Can be integrated with any CEMS Analyser.
Modular design incorporating user programmable features for all sampling, auto blowback, and auto validation sequences.
Optional stack flow & temperature measurement for Mass Emission Monitoring.
Dual HMI at the SSS Probe (SSP) and SSS Controller (SSC).
User friendly HMI graphics, with live and history trends of all temperature zones, blowback pulses, validation pulses & CEMS Analyser readings.
Probe Tip Calibration for determining overall system health.
Reduce maintenance, boost sampling reliability, and increase operational uptime of the CEMS Analyser.

name: ST Line Laser H₂O / H₂S / SO₂ Analyser
summary: Line laser analysers using OF-CEAS spectroscopy for ppb-level H₂O, H₂S and SO₂ measurement in process gas, in Ex p and Ex d versions for hazardous areas.
key: Ex p and Ex d versions
intro: The Stolway Line Laser analysers pump process samples at low pressure through tubing into an optical measurement cell. A vacuum pump guarantees a steady flow while maintaining low pressure, which improves speed and precision.

Inside the cavity the gas interacts with a laser beam and absorbs specific wavelengths; this absorbance is measured to determine the composition. The continuous-flow technology eliminates residue build-up, giving real-time, representative analysis with little delay or interference.

principle.title: Gas sampling
principle.text: Process gas is drawn under controlled vacuum through the resonant optical cell, with dwell times optimised to under 100 ms, eliminating memory effects.

principle.title: Laser locking
principle.text: A frequency-stabilised IR laser couples with a high-finesse optical cavity via optical feedback.

principle.title: Enhanced absorption
principle.text: Multi-pass light–gas interaction in the cavity dramatically increases the effective path length.

principle.title: Quantitative analysis
principle.text: Target gases absorb specific wavelengths; the absorption spectra are fitted to reference databases for precise concentration.

features: OF-CEAS (Optical Feedback Cavity-Enhanced Absorption Spectroscopy) for ppb-level detection with molecular specificity.
Eliminates cross-interference, even in complex gas matrices.
Low-pressure sampling (LPS) minimises interference and improves response time; prevents adsorption losses, condensation and flow hysteresis.
Fast response enables closed-loop control for emissions, combustion and scrubber optimisation.
Solid-state laser and optical design with no consumables such as electrochemical cells or drying cartridges.
Auto-referencing calibration reduces drift and downtime.
IECEx-certified options for hazardous (Zone 1/2) areas.
Ethernet, Modbus and RS485 interfaces for simple connection to control systems.

name: ST LLE-9680 Laser Gas Analyser
summary: A 19-inch rack-mounted tunable diode laser (TDLAS) analyser measuring 1 to 5 gases simultaneously for at-line industrial analysis and environmental monitoring.
intro: The ST LLE-9680 is a 19-inch panel-mounted tunable laser gas analyser designed for at-line industrial analysis and environmental monitoring.

Based on tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS), the analyser scans absorption peaks of the measured gas, free of background gas absorption, and calculates concentration from the second harmonic and line-broadening information. It measures 1 to 5 gases simultaneously from O₂, CO, NH₃, H₂S, HCl, HF, HCN, CO₂, CH₄ and H₂O, with low detection limits.
features: Universal structure, easy to integrate: standard 19-inch 4U chassis with modular internal components.
Strong anti-interference ability, high accuracy, small drift and high stability, using a low-noise semiconductor laser with single-line spectroscopy and wavelength scanning.
1 to 4 laser transmitter modules supporting 1 to 5 customisable parameters on one screen, with short response time and high sensitivity.
Corrosion-resistant key components for petrochemical and other corrosive environments.
Sampling installation directly at the process pipeline, with no moving parts and high reliability.
specs: 1 to 5 of: O₂, CO, NH₃, H₂S, HCl, HF, HCN, CO₂, CH₄, H₂O

name: Tunable Filter Spectroscopy Analyser
menu: Hydrocarbon composition, BTU and Wobbe index
summary: Light-absorption spectroscopy analyser for real-time hydrocarbon composition of natural gas, LNG, LPG, BOG and biogas, with BTU, Wobbe index and density outputs.
intro: The Tunable Filter Spectrometer (TFS) sensor platform consists of a light source, a sample cell, a wavelength-separating element (spectrometer) and a photo-detector.

The wavelength-separating element "slices" the wavelength components of the broadband light source, which then interact with the sample molecules. Some components are absorbed and others pass through; the absorption pattern gives the hydrocarbon composition in real time.
features: Fast one-second response.
No carrier gas or fuel gas required, and no instrument air.
No periodic on-site calibration required; no consumables.
BTU, Wobbe index and density outputs.
Pressure and temperature compensated, with linear response throughout the range.
Minimal sample conditioning required.
Low-power DC operation (AC available).
Remote, completely unattended operation; easy installation and low maintenance.
applications: Pipeline gas quality monitoring (C1–C6 and acid gases)

name: ST DMS-300 Dust Monitor
menu: Dust in wet, low-temperature flue gas
summary: Explosion-proof (positive pressure) extractive dust monitor for low-temperature, high-humidity flue gas, particularly suited to ultra-low emission monitoring in power plants.
intro: Dust monitoring equipment developed for low-temperature and high-humidity working conditions, particularly suitable for monitoring ultra-low emissions in power plants.

The ST DMS-300 (positive pressure explosion-proof version) uses the laser forward-scattering principle. Particulates are extracted isokinetically from the flue into a fully heated gas chamber, where the forward-scattered light is measured and converted into an output signal proportional to concentration. It is designed for explosive gas or dust environments.
features: Laser forward-scattering measurement of particulate concentration.
Isokinetic extraction of particulates from the flue (chimney).
Fully heated gas chamber for low-temperature, high-humidity flue gas.
Positive pressure explosion-proof version for explosive gas or dust environments.
hazard: For use in explosive gas or dust environments

name: ST CO-5300 CO Analyser
summary: NDIR carbon monoxide analyser providing accurate, reliable ppm-level CO detection for atmospheric monitoring.
intro: Based on Non-Dispersive Infrared (NDIR) technology, the CO analyser uses a modular structure and advanced micro-processing to provide accurate and reliable ppm-level CO detection that meets the requirements of atmospheric monitoring.

High-energy infrared light passes alternately through a chamber filled with CO and one without CO via a filter wheel, then through a sample absorption cell with a 14 m effective optical path. The CO concentration is calculated by comparing infrared absorption in the sample with that in the reference gas, following the Beer–Lambert law.
features: High sensitivity, high repeatability and simple operation.
Automatic monitoring of instrument parameters, with continuous self-check and alarm.
Remote calibration and diagnosis; auto zero and span calibration.

name: ST MGC-5800 Multi Gas Calibrator
summary: Dynamic dilution calibrator using high-precision mass flow controllers to supply zero and span gas to analysers, with optional ozone generator and UV photometer.
intro: The dynamic calibrator uses high-precision mass flow controllers and standard gas to supply gas for zero and span testing of analysers by proportional dilution. It can supply four gas sources simultaneously; the optional ozonator and ultraviolet photometer output high-precision ozone and NO₂ standard gas.

Two high-precision mass flow controllers pass a large flow of diluent (zero) gas and a small flow of standard gas, which are mixed evenly in a quartz gas-phase titration chamber to give a proportionally diluted standard gas. The ozonator uses a UV photometer to accurately control oxygen ionisation and produce high-precision O₃.

name: Level Profiler
summary: A "virtual window" into separators and vessels: locates water, emulsion, oil, foam and gas layers without any nuclear sources.
intro: DP and guided wave radar level transmitters, and even mechanical floaters and visual gauges, serve their purpose in light, sweet crudes and wherever water separates easily from oil. Heavier and more viscous crude oils introduce much more complex layers and less defined levels in production separators.

With tight emulsions, long settling times and severe foaming, operators need better information to optimise separator throughput while still avoiding excess water on the oil outlet and liquid carry-over on the gas outlet.

The Stolway Level Profiler uses a series of SeCaP sensors to let operators "see through the walls" of the separator, giving a seamless representation of complex separator layers without any nuclear sources.
features: Accurate location of water, emulsion, oil, foam and free gas layers relative to the top of the weir plate.
Seamless gradient colour for varying water cut across the emulsion layer.
Vertical resolution customised to your requirements (1 cm resolution possible).
Resolution optimised at critical levels in the separator, for example just below the top of the weir plate.
Optional flushing capability for effective cleaning of sensors without affecting production.
